_comment: DEV/TEST-ONLY firm membership: which brand (globalGroup) and country each firm belongs to. Loaded at backend start-up by server/utils/devFirmMembership.js, and ONLY when ALLOW_DEV_AUTH=true and NODE_ENV is not production. Real membership comes from the firms table once the master app supplies the columns and JWT claims — see config/db-schema.sql. Nothing in a request path may write this: membership decides where a manager's saved edits are stored, so a firm able to re-parent itself would read and write another group's content.
_shape: 3 global groups × 3 countries × 3 firms = 27. Country codes, not names, because that is what a JWT claim will carry.
_devTokens: The dev middle-tier tokens in server/middleware/firmAuth.js are globalGroup 'Advisor-e' and country 'DE'. So the Global Group Manager Hub sees the 9 Advisor-e firms, and the Group Manager Hub sees the 3 German ones. Change DEV_GLOBAL_GROUP / DEV_COUNTRY there and these must match.
